title: sprite.ts: group objects in symbol timelines silently dropped (missing flattenDisplayObjects)
description:
packages/swf/src/sprite.ts iterates frame.displayObjects directly (lines 125, 224, 284) without calling flattenDisplayObjects(). compile.ts defines flattenDisplayObjects() (line 1092) as a local helper and calls it at lines 631, 675, 1015 for every frame. When a symbol timeline contains GroupObjects (type='group'), sprite.ts silently skips them because there is no 'group' case in the type switch — compile.ts handles them by recursively expanding their children with accumulated x/y offsets.

Fix: Copy the flattenDisplayObjects() helper from compile.ts into sprite.ts (it is a pure function with no dependencies on compile.ts state), then replace the three direct iterations of frame.displayObjects in sprite.ts with flattenDisplayObjects(frame.displayObjects):
- Line 125: pre-pass depth-seed loop
- Line 224: the main frame displayObjects loop  
- Line 284: the keyframe-pass loops

Acceptance: unit test with a symbol timeline frame that has a GroupObject containing a child SymbolInstance; after encodeDefineSprite, assert that PlaceObject2 is emitted for the child (currently it is not).
